preamble: The open-mid back unrounded [ʌ] centralizes to schwa [ə] in English weak forms. Monosyllabic function words with STRUT in their strong form (but, us, must, some) have weak forms with [ə] when unstressed.

examples.note: The weak form is used whenever the word is unstressed, and the strong form under contrastive stress.

sources: Wikipedia contributors (2026). Weak and strong forms in English. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weak_and_strong_forms_in_English
